text:
For the Blackmagic 6K Full Frame kit, the supplied storage is 1x 1TB CFexpress Type B card (the body records to CFexpress Type B or external USB-C drives).

If you're looking for a cheaper body-only option with built-in ND, the best fit is the Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 6K Pro. It has motorized internal ND filters (0, 2, 4, and 6 stops), an active EF mount, and Super 35 sensor. For 20–21 October (2 days), it is £35/day (£70 total). Its recorded kit includes 5x NP-F570 batteries, a cage, and a hard carry case.

Another cheaper full-frame body option is the Sony FX3 at £49/day (£98 total for 2 days, including a CFexpress Type A card and 2x NP-FZ100 battery sets), though it uses Sony E-mount and does not feature built-in ND filters.

Nothing has been changed or booked on your enquiry—let me know if you'd like to go with either of these options!
